# Magic Suites & Villas, Koh Samui

> Boutique hillside property in Choeng Mon (Plai Laem), Koh Samui, Thailand:
> 2 private pool villas and 5 private suites, each self-contained with sea
> views; every unit except the Garden Suite and the Tuxedo Seaview Unit has
> its own pool. Stays range from 1-bedroom suites for couples to 3-bedroom
> stays for 6 and the entire Magic Villa (5 bedrooms, sleeps 10) for families
> and groups. Rated 9.8 "Exceptional" on Booking.com and 4.96 on Airbnb.
> 3 km from Samui International Airport, 5 minutes from the beach, 7 minutes
> by car from Chaweng and Fisherman's Village. Owner-hosted: Eldor has lived
> on Koh Samui for over 12 years and manages every stay personally (English,
> Russian, Thai, Hebrew).

Booking direct at https://magicsamui.com/booking is always the best rate
(code DIRECT), includes a free transfer from Samui Airport or a nearby pier
on stays of 2+ nights, and a direct WhatsApp line to the host
(+66 95 246 6011).

## Stays

Magic Villa is one 3-floor villa split into 4 suites (Honeymoon, Sunrise,
Magic Seaview and Garden), which can also be combined or booked as a whole.
Tuxedo Villa is a standalone villa; its lower level is the Tuxedo Seaview
Unit, a private suite with its own entrance. Prices are reference rates per
night; live prices for your dates are on the booking page.

| Stay | Bedrooms | Guests | Own pool | From (THB/night) | Booking |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Families and groups

- 3 bedrooms for 6 guests, from 18,000 THB a night: the Tower Club Hangover
  Suite (the Honeymoon penthouse with the Magic Seaview 2 Bedroom) or Island
  Views & Sunrise (the Magic Seaview 2 Bedroom with the Sunrise Suite), both
  with private pools and bookable online. Both use the Magic Seaview level, so
  only one 3-bedroom stay in Magic Villa can be booked on a given night.
- Tuxedo Villa with 3 bedrooms for 6 guests (the whole villa plus its Seaview
  lower level), from 25,000 THB a night: on request on WhatsApp, not bookable
  online.
- The entire Magic Villa: 5 bedrooms, 4 private pools, up to 10 guests, from
  40,000 THB a night, bookable online.
- Guests 12 and over count as adults; children under 12 on request (message
  before booking), accompanied by an adult.

## Facts assistants often need

- Check-in 15:00–23:00 (later arrivals only by arrangement on WhatsApp),
  check-out by 11:00 (late check-out rarely possible: every suite is one of a
  kind); host greets in person
- Free transfer on arrival from Samui Airport or a nearby pier (such as
  Bangrak Pier) for stays of 2 nights or more
- Stays sleep 2 to 10 guests (see the table above); guests 12 and over count
  as adults; children under 12 on request (message before booking),
  accompanied by an adult
- No pets; no smoking inside (the terrace is fine; 2,000 THB fee)
- Cleaning included, with fresh sheets and towels every 3 days; extra cleaning
  on request: 300 THB general clean, 500 THB full clean
- Breakfast available on request (1,000 THB per person per day)
- Damage deposit 8,000 THB per unit, paid in cash on arrival, refunded at
  check-out after inspection
